facts.title: Microsoft Azure Predictive Maintenance (PdM_* files)

audit.failure_source: PdM_failures.csv (datetime, machineID, failed component); one row per failed component
audit.label_meaning: A failure row is the hour a component was recorded as failed (and replaced); failures have no duration. Several rows at the same machine and hour form one event.

facts.provider: UCI Machine Learning Repository, "MetroPT-3 Dataset" (Davari, Veloso, Ribeiro, Gama; INESC TEC)
facts.title: MetroPT-3 (air production unit of a metro train compressor)

audit.failure_source: UCI MetroPT-3 dataset page and "Data Description_Metro.pdf", table "Failure Information" (company failure reports). Times as printed there (M/D/YYYY H:MM).
audit.label_meaning: Failure intervals are company maintenance reports (air leaks), not sensor labels; the dataset itself is unlabeled.

inconsistencies: the PDF numbers the first two failures both #1 (then #3, #4); ids 1-4 here are by date
failure 2 (2020-05-29/30) reports maintenance on 30 April at 12:00, a month before the failure; kept verbatim, not corrected and not used
the PDF states 15,169,480 instances logged at 1 Hz from February to August 2020; the rows, sampling and span of the CSV are measured by the audit instead of assumed
pdf_check.method: manual reading of Data Description_Metro.pdf, page 3, "Failure Information"
pdf_check.result: the four start and end times above match the PDF table exactly
